'''Voltage generators''' were a type of [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] installed on [[Trang Robotics]]' [[Duelist Elite/Legends|Duelist Elites]]. Considered to be an archaic method of power generation by the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the usage of the generator was considered to be part of the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] charm. The voltage generator powered the [[induction spur]] that created a low-level [[Electromagnetic field/Legends|electromagnetic field]], as well as the droid's internal systems.<ref name="EGTD" />
